data.notes: 17 of 20 WebSearch calls used. Predecessors: Touareg 7L (2002-2010) and 7P (2010-2018, split at 2014 facelift for +6 mm length); Touran 1T (2003-2015) split into three entries (original, 2006 facelift GP, 2010 facelift GP2) because length/height changed. Touareg 7P facelift wheelbase conflict: ADAC 2904 vs. 2893 mm elsewhere.

corrections.evidence: ADAC (V6 TSI Hybrid 04/10-08/14): Systemleistung 279 kW (380 PS); the 3.0 V6 TSI combustion engine alone is 245 kW (333 PS) plus 34 kW (47 PS) e-motor. Autozeitung headline 'VW Touareg Hybrid: V6-Stromer mit 380 PS'. 333 PS is the petrol engine only, not system output.

missing.detail: 7P Facelift 2014: V6 TSI Hybrid 4MOTION Tiptronic (08/14-06/15) exists in ADAC catalogue (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/touareg/ii-facelift/242774/): length 4801 mm, wheelbase 2893 mm, trunk 493/1555 l, 380 PS system output, powertrain hev, awd true.

7P (2010-2014): V6 FSI / V6 FSI BMT 4MOTION petrol (ADAC 05/10-06/13, https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/touareg/ii/223788) and V8 TDI not listed as variants (trunk expected 580/1642 l, not separately verified).

7L: R5 TDI (2.5 l, 174 PS), V6 3.2/3.6 FSI petrol (ADAC V6 FSI 11/08-02/10, https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/touareg/i-facelift/216779), W12 and R50 variants not listed. Trunk values not separately verified.

1T Facelift 2006 (GP): 1.4 TSI EcoFuel (CNG, 150 PS, 05/09-04/10) missing; ADAC lists 695/1989 l (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/touran/i-facelift/218865). It replaced the 2.0 EcoFuel (yearTo 2009).

verification.notes: 11 WebSearch calls used. Confirmed: Touareg 7L 4754/1928/1726(1703 V10)/2855, 555/1570 (VW Ireland/VW.de also list a 500-1525 l range without variant attribution - not enough to correct). Touareg 7P 4795/1940/1709/2893, 580/1642, hybrid 493/1555 (ADAC). 7P facelift 4801/1940/1709, 580/1642; ADAC V6 TDI SCR BMT page indeed shows wheelbase 2904 mm, but ADAC facelift Hybrid (242774) and Executive Edition (258516) list 2893 mm, so 2893 retained (unresolved, counted as not confirmed). Touran 1T 4391/1794/1635/2677, 695/1989 (ADAC 1.9 TDI and 1.6); GP 4407/1635/2678 and GP2 4397/1674 confirmed by VW official touran-1 page; GP2 CNG 592/1886 confirmed (ADAC 223974; ADAC names it '1.4 TSI EcoFuel' in some entries and '1.4 TGI BlueMotion' in others, 150 PS) - could set powerPs 150 for that variant. 2.0 EcoFuel 109 PS confirmed. Note: the 2006-facelift (GP) 1.4 TSI EcoFuel 05/09-04/10 had 695/1989 l, whereas the GP2 version has 592/1886 l.
